controls.immutableSource: release-source-<sha> artifact and source SHA reachable from main
controls.featureFlag: module-specific flag remains disabled until the approved stage
controls.killSwitch: a documented per-unit switch must stop new promotion and the module fallback must remain available
controls.rollback: redeploy the previous attested SHA through the canonical publisher; migrations remain additive
controls.automaticInterruption: a stage may not advance when error, latency, or journey evidence exceeds policy

core-workers.pilotCanary: blocked: dual Worker version affinity and external SLO evidence are not configured

crm-pages.rollback: previous Pages deployment or previous staging-attested SHA
crm-pages.pilotCanary: blocked: Pages traffic steering and pilot cohort configuration are not configured

escala-api.pilotCanary: blocked: Worker gradual routing and external SLO evidence are not configured

timekeeping.featureFlag: environment deploy gate and Ponto operational flag
timekeeping.rollback: previous staging-attested SHA with additive-migration compatibility
timekeeping.pilotCanary: blocked: Worker gradual routing, network-context pilot cohort and external SLO evidence are not configured

meta-ads-report.pilotCanary: blocked: job-level canary and external ingestion journey evidence are not configured
